title: Nominal root zone for a retained significant tree (AS4970)
text: C1.2.5 Where a significant existing tree is retained on site, a nominal root zone is to be provided in accordance with AS4970.

replaces.note: tree protection zone -> nominal root zone

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

verified.note: Requirement clear on the page; the 'nominal root zone' terminology query (not an AS4970 term) is a drafting matter and stays in notes.

notes: Applies only where a significant existing tree is retained (rule condition). 'Nominal root zone' is not an AS4970 term (AS4970 uses tree protection zone and structural root zone); drafting query.
